description: Source code for the 'send-pack' functionality in Git, handling pack creation, object transmission, status reporting, and push certificate generation.

methods.name: option_parse_push_signed
methods.description: Parses and sets the push signing option based on user input.

methods.name: pack_objects
methods.description: Creates a pack stream of objects and writes it to the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: receive_unpack_status
methods.description: Reads and interprets the remote unpack status from the packet reader.

methods.name: receive_status
methods.description: Processes status reports from the remote side after push.

methods.name: sideband_demux
methods.description: Demultiplexes sideband data from the remote side.

methods.name: check_to_send_update
methods.description: Determines if a ref should be sent based on its status and push options.

methods.name: generate_push_cert
methods.description: Generates a push certificate for the refs being pushed.

methods.name: reject_invalid_nonce
methods.description: Validates the nonce for push certificate signing.

methods.name: get_commons_through_negotiation
methods.description: Negotiates common objects with the remote repository.

methods.name: send_pack
methods.description: Main function to send pack data, handle refs, status, and communication with remote.
